list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation (Exophase / PSNProfiles, frozen 2026-11-18). Hidden flags and Gamerscore are platform data (Exophase / TrueAchievements / PSNProfiles): 28 hidden, 27 visible, 1,000 Gamerscore in total.
sources_note: Guides are written in this entry's own words. Methods that come from firsthand play are credited to PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Nov 18, 2026, powerpyx.com) and, where noted, GTABase. Anything not yet confirmed in the game is labelled 'not yet checked in the game'.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then character strands, activities, crime, and finally the 100% cleanup — and this one closes the set. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full run; there is no shortcut. Only one trophy is potentially missable (Positive Mental Attitude — see Missables), and four have no established method yet.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, as Jason — it is the first mission of Chapter 1, so you cannot miss it. Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission and the trophy pops on completion. This is a story trophy, so the spoiler setting hides its name until you earn it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter-completion trophies can pop slightly late — PowerPyx notes they sometimes land a mission or two into the next chapter — so keep playing if it does not pop the instant the chapter ends. Nothing in Chapter 1 is missable for the Platinum except the one optional meditation in Positive Mental Attitude, which you should do while you are here.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy can pop a little after the chapter itself ends, a mission or two into Chapter 3 — that is normal, per PowerPyx, not a bug. Chapter 2 is also where Jason and Lucia become playable together after the mission Coffee Break, which unlocks partner activities and several other trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies, the pop can lag a mission or two into the next chapter. Chapter 3 unlocks several tools the rest of the Platinum needs — the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun, and the Dye Pack Jammer — so finish the chapter before chasing the robbery and collectible trophies that depend on them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists the final mission under Chapter 4, while the Operation Savage Glory trophy sits in Chapter 5, so treat Chapter 5 as a short epilogue after this one. The trophy can pop a mission or two late, as with the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero (PowerPyx lists it under Chapter 4). This is the last story beat: once it is done, Leonida opens up for free-roam cleanup and the 100% checklist becomes visible under Progress, with everything you already did during the story counting toward it. Worth 50 Gamerscore on Xbox — not 100, as one aggregator claims; the per-trophy values sum to exactly 1,000 with 50 here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it comes to you in the normal flow of the chapter — play the missions in order and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Not missable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission like the rest of this set: follow the chapter's mission order and it pops on completion. Not missable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story mission, earned in the normal flow of the chapter. Not missable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story mission, earned in the normal flow of the chapter. Not missable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission, earned in the normal flow of the chapter. Not missable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Chapter 5 is a short epilogue after Chapter 4, so this is one of the last story trophies you will earn. Not missable.

counter.extra: 35-task checklist. Animals studied: 0/100 (100% target; no definitive species total).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it only becomes visible after the story, though progress made during the story already counts). The checklist has 35 tasks, but most ask for only part of a total, so 100% here is closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 animals studied (no definitive species total — reports differ), 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets. Only a few tasks demand everything — all 39 Gang Operations, all 42 Shooting Range golds, all 42 Drone Time Trials, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, and all Underwater Discoveries. Nothing on the list is missable; all of it can be finished in free roam after the story. The animal total is disputed across outlets (255 per PowerPyx, over 160 elsewhere), but the requirement — study 100 — is agreed. This is the long tail of the Platinum: leave it for Stage 5 and tick off its tasks alongside the other trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. There are 397 in the world — 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, per PowerPyx — and the 100% checklist wants 300, so you will keep going past this trophy anyway. Stunts count as you play naturally, and the in-game Progress menu tracks them. Fastest approach: work through jumps and under-bridge stunts in a fast car or bike while exploring, and save the trickier knife flights and base jumps for the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt (the list of nine comes from PowerPyx — the description itself does not enumerate them). You only need one try at each, not a win, so this is a quick tour: play a round of golf, shoot one round at a range, sink a ball at pool, and so on. Most of these will happen naturally while you chase the other activity trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn 42 gold medals at the Shooting Ranges — 12 courses across 2 ranges. Every medal must be gold — silver or bronze does not count — and the 100% checklist also demands all 42 gold, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly. Practice each challenge until the gold threshold is comfortable, and redo any challenge you only just passed; there is no penalty for retrying. Track progress in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. You need a win at each location, not just a finish. The related Drone Time Trials (42 of them) are a separate 100% requirement, so drone flying is worth practising: learn the racing line at each location, then go for the win. Locations unlock as you explore Leonida, so this is a Stage 3 activity.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: replaying the same race does not add to the count, so work through the race list across Leonida instead of farming one favourite. Street races count toward the Strangers & Freaks strand Yago as well, so combine the two where you can.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After you meet Cal in Chapter 1 he texts you a fishing spot, and the fishing questline runs through those messages (PowerPyx). Head to the spot he sends, take the challenge, and out-fish him. Fishing also counts toward Master of None, so this is a natural first activity trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are three games on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines out in the world, per PowerPyx — pick whichever you find first and play it through to the end. This also ticks the video-game activity for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand: five quests in the Cellerica chain around Belville, playable as Lucia, starting in Chapter 3 (PowerPyx). Work through Andy's missions in order; the trophy pops when the last one ends. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, and it is available in free roam after the story, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand: seven shipwrecks to find by treasure diving around Key Lento. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, then returns in Chapters 2–3 as Jason; PowerPyx notes a shortcut — call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2. Dive each wreck, finish the strand's last mission, and the trophy pops. Not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand: five quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (PowerPyx). Play through Billy's missions in order; the trophy pops at the end of the last one. Not missable.

counter.extra: 4 strands confirmed (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete); rest unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Four counting strands are confirmed by PowerPyx: Kirk (the Skunk Ape), Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this total. The remaining four counting strands are not yet confirmed — PowerPyx says more strangers are yet to be discovered — so this guide lists only the four confirmed ones and labels the rest as not yet checked in the game. Do not assume a stranger counts until it is confirmed; keep exploring Leonida and check back as new strands are published. Yago's strand includes a timed invitation (Race Against Yago) — accept it when it appears as a precaution; no firsthand evidence either way on whether an expired invitation can be recovered.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand: 16 sports cars on his wish list, using the Key Cloner — unlocked in Chapter 3, in the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS mission chain (PowerPyx). Steal each car on the list, deliver it, and finish Randy's last mission. Not missable.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand: destroy the Synthetic Labs, then play the mission Spin On This, available after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty and playable as Jason (PowerPyx). Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. Not missable.

counter.extra: 10 locations including the balcony; 15/18 is the separate 100% target.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both characters at a spot counts +2, so always bring your partner; track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations (PowerPyx). The final meditation only becomes possible once both characters are playable together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. MISSABLE WARNING — the only possibly-missable trophy in the game: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason's house, and PowerPyx observed the counter rise +1 — but states twice that it is currently unclear whether that meditation is required for the trophy. The Chapter 1 spot is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the other 18. Do it in Chapter 1 anyway to be safe: it costs a minute. No same-save evidence shows whether skipping it blocks the trophy, so no claim is made here either way.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is the hunting questline: 15 Target Decks, with the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69, available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and playable as Jason (PowerPyx). The exact animal that unlocks the trophy is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx says it is still undergoing confirmation — so do not trust any single-animal claim yet. Clearing all 15 Target Decks is required for 100% anyway and should cover the trophy, but that is inference, not confirmation: labelled here as not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total and the 100% checklist wants 15, so this trophy is an early milestone on a much longer collectible hunt (PowerPyx). Cards are scattered across Leonida; pick up every card you pass while doing other things, and save a dedicated sweep for the cleanup stage. Track sets in the Collections menu.

counter.extra: Guide lists 89 locations — not the complete pool.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It — the in-game scanning app — at 100 locations. Scan environmental objects as you explore: PowerPyx counts 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures among the scannable types, and more than 100 locations exist in total, so you have slack. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good (scan vehicles) and exploring for The Goodtime State: scan everything you pass instead of making a separate trip for it.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 in the game and the 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy is a waypoint on the way to the bigger target (PowerPyx). Track them under Progress, then Challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities, so they accumulate as you play everything else — pick off the easy ones deliberately in the cleanup stage and the count will follow.

trophies.condition: Escape a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner in one attempt.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape the heat. It unlocks earliest after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters are playable together; call your partner with hold Right and Triangle (PowerPyx). A reliable escape route PowerPyx gives is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — drive through it and break line of sight. It can also pop automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… if you lose the heat there with your partner along.

trophies.condition: Rob 3 consecutive shops with your partner, retaining the Wanted Level throughout.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your Wanted Level. PowerPyx's route: 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so do not panic if it does not pop instantly. One wrinkle PowerPyx notes: if you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need a fourth store for the count to register — keep robbing until it pops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. There are 557 vehicles in total but 277 base models, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned — this resolves the 277-versus-557 confusion in early reports (PowerPyx). Scan every new vehicle you see while driving around Leonida; car parks, traffic and mission vehicles all count. Do it alongside You WAiNKer! and The Goodtime State.

trophies.condition: Take down 5 enemies in one single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming. PowerPyx's setup: boost your focus first with food and drinks, washing your face or showering, and Adrenaline, then use a strong rifle — the Duke 556 assault rifle — against a group of criminals at a Gang Operation, where enemies cluster. One caution, labelled as a single author's observation and not yet corroborated: PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so aim for gang criminals. If it does not pop, retry at another Gang Operation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane at Vice City International Airport and take off with it. The plane must be docked to a departure terminal — connected to a boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not work. PowerPyx names terminals E3 and E4 as the easiest, and says to fly about 1 km away from the airport. The unlock is delayed, so keep flying after takeoff instead of landing at once.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it. The description is a joke with no explicit mechanic; the trigger comes from PowerPyx's firsthand play: tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of Mariana County. Get into a tank, drive it out, and shoot enemies with it. Expect heavy resistance at the base, so go in with full health and a fast exit plan.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you (PowerPyx) — do not attempt this before Chapter 3. With the Snap Gun equipped, enter the store, take the valuables quietly, and leave without tripping the alarm or being spotted. If you are detected, leave and try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe); then tail a security van to a bank and bring your partner along (PowerPyx). After that, you can pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — which requires his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: 5 for this trophy, all 8 for 100%. A single bank can pay up to $205,000, which also feeds Dime on the Dollar. Escape the heat after each vault before the next.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is… — so most players get it while setting up the bank jobs (PowerPyx). The earlier standalone method also works: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door open, take the cash, and escape the red heat radius — the trophy only pops once you are clear of the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — explore every part of Leonida. PowerPyx's fastest route is by plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the fog lift. On the ground, drive every road you have not covered. This pairs with Whip It Good and You WAiNKer!: scan vehicles and locations as you explore, and the three trophies progress together.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for this trophy. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist wants all 39, so keep going after the trophy pops. Track which gangs you have hit under Progress, then Gangs (PowerPyx). Gang Operations are also good hunting grounds for Gunslinger, since enemies cluster there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A lead, reported on Xbox and now in the PowerPyx walkthrough — not yet checked on PS5. Xbox players report: go to the Oceanview Hotel rooftop bar on Ocean Beach, take the rooftop-access elevator, buy the $10 apple martini and drink it. A second Xbox player reported the same method working. That is Xbox evidence, not PS5 proof: the trigger has not been confirmed on PlayStation, so treat the bar, the elevator and the drink as a lead to try in free roam, not a verified step.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. PowerPyx played this firsthand and adds the details that matter: you need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, and only the blue Banshee works — other cars in the showroom do not trigger it. The unlock is slightly delayed after the smash, so keep driving.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn during its gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, opened with Sticky Bombs (PowerPyx, firsthand). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick the items up. It is NOT missable — the robbery icon respawns, so you can return for anything you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both characters. The description is a joke with no explicit mechanic; the trigger comes from PowerPyx's firsthand play: only after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership — and always go together, because while one character works out, the other automatically completes training too, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story. One platform-data note: most trackers mark this trophy hidden, but Push Square does not — this guide follows the majority and marks it hidden.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions. The description gives no count; the 500 figure and the counting method come from PowerPyx's firsthand play, corroborated by GTABase. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first — Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile set to On — and a demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. You can view your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Your actions shape a profile — Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, or Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid it if you care about the other profiles. The count builds across the whole playthrough, so this usually pops late.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet checked in the game. The description is a joke with no mechanic, and no source has confirmed how this trophy fires. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and notes only speculation — that it may be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — which is a guess, not a method. Do not treat the Payday Loans link as fact. This guide will update when a firsthand report confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A lead, reported on Xbox and now in the PowerPyx walkthrough — not yet checked on PS5. Xbox players report a roadside UFO encounter as the trigger. That is Xbox evidence, not PS5 proof: no firsthand PlayStation report has confirmed the encounter, its location, or what sets it off, so treat the UFO link as a lead, not a verified method. This guide will update when a firsthand PS5 report confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet checked in the game. The description names the action — a melee drive-by — but not the trigger: which vehicle, which attack, or what counts as a hit. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and notes only speculation — kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — which is a guess, not a method. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but that is a hint, not a confirmed trigger. This guide will update when a firsthand report confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — cumulative, not in one go. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then bring marked bills to a Fence; PowerPyx notes Yasmani pays the most. Bank vaults are the biggest source of marked bills — up to $205,000 from a single robbery — so this trophy progresses alongside Maximum Withdrawal. Keep laundering after every bank job and the $250,000 total will arrive on its own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The fastest spending, per PowerPyx, is guns, car modifications and tattoos. Money spent on story requirements and gear counts, so a good share of this will happen naturally; in the cleanup stage, buy the most expensive weapon attachments and car mods you have not yet bought until the total crosses $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garages, for $160,000 in total (PowerPyx). Garages become available after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Buy them as you can afford them — garage space is also what On the Spot needs, since registered vehicles need somewhere to go.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks after Chapter 2's Moses mission: drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register (PowerPyx). Make sure you have garage space first — buy garages under Little Boxes if you are full. Early on, only vehicles without trackers can be registered; from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
